title: Job
author: The author is not named.
date: Set in the patriarchal world; the date of writing is uncertain.
audience: God's people, teaching wisdom concerning suffering, faith, humility, and God's sovereignty.
historicalSetting: Job wrestles with righteous suffering, human limitation, false explanations, and the majesty of God.
keyVerse: Job 19:25 — "But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives."
christFocus: Job points to Christ as the living Redeemer and the righteous sufferer. It prepares the heart to trust God beyond what can be seen or understood.
